title: Release package requires the pre-built JS UI; dev/build.py guards it before building
answers: release mlflow package missing the web UI
mlflow wheel shipped without the UI assets
why does the release build fail saying mlflow/server/js/build is missing or empty
do I need to build the frontend before packaging mlflow
body:
Symptom: the full mlflow package installs but the tracking server UI is missing or broken.
Root cause: setup.py package_data bundles mlflow/server/js/build only if it exists at build time; the UI is built by the workflow, not by Python packaging.
Fix pattern: dev/build.py:main checks that JS_BUILD_DIR (mlflow/server/js/build) exists and is non-empty before the release build, and exits with the yarn build instructions otherwise. Keep this guard before any build call on the release path.
Constraints: the guard applies only to `--package-type release`; the skinny path has no UI and must not require it. If the UI build output location changes in setup.py or the JS build, update JS_BUILD_DIR together with it.
applies: branch-2.11 release packaging of the full mlflow package; not the skinny package.
says: The tracking server interface is missing after installing the full release package.
Users see a blank screen instead of the web dashboard on installed servers.
Why does packaging fail when frontend assets have not been compiled beforehand?
Our released distribution shipped without the web console interface bundled inside it.
Prevent publishing packages if the user interface files were not generated first.
search: Release packaging in dev/build.py:main must verify that JS_BUILD_DIR (mlflow/server/js/build) exists and is non-empty before initiating release builds, exiting with yarn build instructions if missing. This guard applies exclusively to branch-2.11 release packaging of the full package with --package-type release, not to the skinny package. If the frontend build destination changes in setup.py or the JavaScript build configuration, JS_BUILD_DIR must be updated accordingly.
